weather_report:
As night wraps its cool embrace around Boston, the air is thick with the scent of rain, and an unmistakable haze cloaks the city, shrouding the familiar skyline in a soft, velvety fog. Tonight, the clouds gather heavier than usual, ready to spill their burdens, casting a sleepy gloom over streets that seem to whisper of missed journeys and fleeting moments. The chance of thunder rumbling across the horizon adds a discordant note to the otherwise serene atmosphere, while the temperature hovers around a cool 52 degrees, inviting those who venture outside to wrap themselves in layers that offer both comfort and protection.

As dawn approaches tomorrow, the rainfall is expected to linger, tapering off only slightly to allow hints of sun to peek through the clouds. Locals may find themselves greeted by a brief interlude of brightness before the afternoon chill sets in, urging all to dress in cozy attire — perhaps a soft sweater beneath a light jacket, paired with waterproof shoes, perfect for the damp ground underfoot. The gentle gusts of wind will carry the scent of fresh rain, beckoning a stroll through the quieter corners of the city or a visit to a favorite café, where warm drinks await those seeking solace from the elements. With much of the day promising an interplay between rain and illumination, it might be a perfect time to indulge in simple joys — a taste of homemade pastries or the turning of pages in a well-loved book — while the world outside swirls with the soft melody of falling rain.
